title: Come Out & Come Across
situation: Checking the result of a repair with a test bag.
objective: Use come out and come across to talk about results and finding something.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When I finish a repair, I wait for the test bag to come out of the machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah selesai memperbaiki, saya menunggu tas uji keluar dari mesin.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If the bag comes out normally, the machine is working well.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika tas keluar dengan normal, berarti mesin berfungsi dengan baik.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I come across a damaged cable while I am checking the machine.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya menemukan kabel yang rusak saat memeriksa mesin.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When I come across something unusual, I take a photo and write it in my report.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika menemukan sesuatu yang tidak biasa, saya memotret dan menulisnya di laporan saya.

learningNotes: come out berarti keluar dari suatu tempat.
come across berarti menemukan sesuatu tanpa sengaja.
while I am checking berarti saat saya sedang memeriksa.
